prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Unbranded One / M01 revised single full-body mecha source design, R13. ONE robot only.

Primary request: redesign the stature and armor architecture of the teal mass-production mecha so it visibly belongs to the SAME FICTIONAL MECHA SERIES as Complete King. It is a supporting mass-production combat type from that series, but an important protagonist of THIS game: understated and memorable, with the dignity and latent charisma to carry a heroic martial-arts moment. It must not look short, dim, cute, aquatic, turtle-like, kappa-like, or like a sports mascot.

Input images:
1. Complete King: PRIMARY FAMILY LANGUAGE and current KINETIC_CEL rendering reference. The navy/ivory/red/gold King is the originally designated lavish lead machine, bulky and excessively armed. Do NOT copy its full equipment or navy palette onto M01.
2. Previously approved M01 head: retain ONLY its identifying design vocabulary and colors: solid ivory center crest spine flanked by TWO parallel ochre-gold recessed channels, small separate lower gold forehead insert, mirrored straight rearward temple antennae, one continuous amber optical visor, smooth closed ivory faceplate, teal/ivory/ochre. The old wide round helmet volume is what needs refinement; do not repeat the big dome.

NEW PROPORTIONS:
Adult heroic athletic combat chassis, approximately 7.8 to 8 head-lengths tall. SMALLER, narrower, sharply faceted head; longer thighs and shins; recognizable neck, lifted upper torso, high hip articulation. Legs occupy a little more than half of standing height. Natural confident narrow stance, not a squat, bow-legged pose. Shoulder width about three head widths; medium lean muscular torso, stable waist, not skinny. Arms and hands anatomically continuous, elbow near waist, wrists reach upper thigh. Feet compact beveled mechanical boots with narrow toes, neither sneakers nor flippers. No chibi scaling, melon helmet, tiny legs, thick duck feet, round hunchback or protruding beak.

SAME-SERIES ARMOR:
Translate King's core body's construction into a simpler production type. Four visible shared motifs:
- the same compact faceted helmet/jaw construction and chamfered temple joints, but M01's modest single dorsal crest and rearward antennae instead of King's elaborate multi-prong crown.
- paired angular pectoral shells framing a shallow shield-shaped CENTRAL CHEST ARMOR PANEL with chamfered corners; two SMALL recessed horizontal ochre cooling louver blocks, one on either side. This panel family must look related to King's champion chest, but no ornamental champion crest or oversized jewelry. Retain a modest plain rectangular latch on M01's own left chest, integrated into a seam rather than a diagonal harness.
- stepped trapezoid shoulder shells and compact exposed circular shoulder couplings, mirroring the construction of King's shoulder armor without its oversized rank panels or wing roots. White top plates, teal lower armor. Shoulder points sit down and outward, not tall mascot ears.
- the same bevel rhythm on ivory thighs/shins, angular kneecap inset, compact round elbow/knee/ankle couplings and narrow graphite abdomen. Reduced part count and fewer gold borders than the King.

MEMORABLE M01 SIGNATURE:
An elegant raised ivory longitudinal crown with SOLID WHITE CENTER and TWO GOLD SIDE GROOVES, never one yellow central stripe. Compact sharpened teal brow over a thin serious amber visor. Ivory closed mask, no mouth slots or beak. Temple antennae symmetric and straight backward with no folded elbow.
Two functional raised ochre impact rails on the outside/dorsal face of the forearms, integrated into simple rectangular bracers, and three gold dorsal knuckle plates. The fists look capable, not enormous Social Brave King fists. This distinctive forearm-to-fist gold rhythm is readable in a punch silhouette. Plain central chest panel, restrained repair seams and practical open hip articulation. One slightly different lower left shoulder service panel is acceptable; face and crown stay symmetric.
No wings, backpack cannons, drill, carried shield, cape, sword, hair, elaborate royal crest, promotion markings, decorative samurai skirt or added character insignia.

PALETTE AND STYLE:
Keep M01's own ivory armor, deeper petrol-teal main plates, restrained ochre-gold structural accents and amber visor; charcoal joints. Do not repaint it all navy/red like King. Same precise KINETIC_CEL ink and crisp two-step painted shadows as input 1, rich large color blocks, controlled mechanical seam density. No glossy 3D toy, PBR metal, chrome, gritty photo texture, bloom, neon trim or thick plastic outlines.

Composition: one full-length robot in a composed three-quarter near-frontal view, head to sole fully visible, camera around sternum height with negligible perspective distortion, one foot a small half-step forward, fists relaxed but ready. Show the actual long-leg proportions clearly. Tall portrait canvas with a little margin around crown, shoulder and feet. No dramatic foreshortening. No labels, logos, letters, number, second robot or diagram inset. Actual transparent background, no floor, checkerboard, haze or cast shadow.
